title: Work Day Scheduler
description: Daily planner for scheduling hourly appointments, with entries saved in Local Storage. Built with JavaScript.

title: Artist Hop
description: Front-end app for discovering new musical artists related to one you search for, using the Last.fm and TheAudioDB APIs. Built with jQuery. Team project.

title: REALSOUL
description: Responsive website for REALSOUL, an arts organization creating K-8 educational resources rooted in social justice, community, and art learning.

title: EVCA
description: Responsive website for a west-coast trade association representing EV charging infrastructure companies, covering its advocacy work, membership, and policy priorities.

title: Youth Wellness Movement
description: Responsive website for the Youth Wellness Movement, covering its mission and its resources for youth, educators, and research.

title: SACC AAPI Night Market
description: Website previewing the AAPI Night Market, featuring over 50 food vendors and event attractions.

title: NewsCycle
description: Full stack MERN app for quickly cycling through top news headlines, with options to read, share, or save articles for later. Team project.

title: Note Taker
description: Notepad app that reads and writes notes to a JSON file. Built with Node, Express, and JavaScript.

title: Burger App
description: MVC app built with Node, Handlebars, and MySQL/Sequelize where you create a burger and click to eat it.

title: PuckMan Chase
description: Browser game using the Planck.js physics engine: avoid the asteroids for as long as you can. Built with Node, MySQL/Sequelize, and JavaScript. Team project.
